entry.title: Generated pages
entry.summary: How a page generator can hide capped pages before the sidebar is built.
entry.content: A tool that writes hundreds of pages can mark each one with sidebar: { hidden: true } when its hub is over the cap, so Starlight never builds the entries the cap would drop. The toolkit’s cappedChildHidden(count, cap) says when. The sidebar, the current entry and the previous and next links are the same with or without the hint.
